episodes.title: The Grand Design
episodes.summary: The Prime Minister's plans for the country's defence manage to antagonise the Civil Service and the military. Is Hacker really the right man to have his finger on the nuclear button?

episodes.title: The Ministerial Broadcast
episodes.summary: Jim is being coached for his first TV broadcast as Prime Minister, but Sir Humphrey seems more concerned with what he says than how he says it.

episodes.title: The Smoke Screen
episodes.summary: A radical plan to deter people from smoking by raising taxes leaves Sir Humphrey fuming. He calls in the tobacco lobby to ensure there's no smoke without fire.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.summary: What can a PM do when his Cabinet Secretary is getting above himself? Jim's answer is to lock Sir Humphrey out of Number 10.

episodes.title: A Real Partnership
episodes.summary: Backbench MPs want a pay rise, the Civil Service want a pay rise and the government has a financial crisis. Something's got to give and this time it's not going to be the PM - probably.

episodes.title: A Victory for Democracy
episodes.summary: Is the Foreign Office carrying out government policy or is the government there to carry out Foreign Office policy? Hacker is about to find out.

episodes.title: The Bishops Gambit
episodes.summary: Sir Humphrey wants the PM to appoint an old friend to the post of Bishop of Bury St Edmunds. But Hacker's got a nurse in a Middle East prison to sort out first.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.summary: Jim's sliding down the nation's popularity polls. It takes a spy, a sheepdog and an expensive army operation to improve his standing.

episodes.title: Man Overboard
episodes.summary: The PM is in favour of the plan to create civilian jobs by moving servicemen north, until Sir Humphrey hints that the Employment Secretary is plotting against him.

episodes.title: Official Secrets
episodes.summary: When the former PM's memoirs have to be scrutinised for security reasons, Jim receives a chapter that makes him look bad.

episodes.title: A Diplomatic Incident
episodes.summary: The sudden death of the former PM gives Hacker an opportunity to host a state occasion and to make sure his predecessor is dead.

episodes.title: A Conflict of Interest
episodes.summary: As rumours spread of a scandal in the City, Sir Humphrey knows that the only way to avoid disaster depends on the new Governor of the Bank of England. But will the PM appoint the right man?

episodes.title: Power to the People
episodes.summary: Hacker is having problems with local government, especially a member of Houndsworth Council, who wants to abolish parliament, the courts and the monarchy. Is it time for Hacker's Reform Bill?

episodes.title: The Patron of the Arts
episodes.summary: The PM is to speak at the televised British Theatre Awards Dinner. Unfortunately, the Arts Council grant was less than generous and the Director of the National Theatre is introducing Hacker's speech.

episodes.title: The National Education Service
episodes.summary: The education system is a disaster. Jim could always axe the Department of Education. But what would Sir Humphrey say?

episodes.title: The Tangled Web
episodes.summary: Hacker has committed the ultimate political sin - lying to the House. Humphrey feels he has a moral responsibility to tell the truth, unless Hacker can employ some gentle persuasion.
